migrate/migrate_test.go the journal converter is a pure codec with one row per journal shape, and no contract row reads an engine journal
banner_test.go Options.Version empty is Go API: serve always passes a version, so no row runs without the engine banner
codex_test.go ModelTransport is a Go API option with no serve equivalent; it supplies the key and dials the websocket
commands_test.go a panicking command operation, a typed command during Close, and the route walk of spec Contract source reach no driver
runtime_test.go fake-backend helpers of the synctest race tests; New refuses runtime-ignored keys only in the Go API; no harnesstest reply records an item and then fails
session_test.go live frames are ephemeral and goldens hold none; a full subscriber dropping deltas is a race
tools_test.go Options.Tools and Restrict are Go API with no serve equivalent; an embedder tool name cannot be written in the serve config, so no contract row reaches the New collision with a built-in name
mcp_test.go AllowedTools at Create has no serve oracle: the engine create takes no allowed tools
plugin_test.go plugin start failures surface at Create here and at serve start on the engine; Create after Close is Go API
reads_test.go both hosts open each session with work at start, so no row isolates a read that must not open a session
goaltool_test.go the goal tool rows wait on the runtime: its evaluator transcript, its refusal wording, and the withdrawal of a set condition by adjust differ from serve
